grammar.summary: 本课讲述作者新年决心的制定与放弃，运用了条件状语从句表达推理，用分词短语作状语描述锻炼与阅读的状态，并通过过去完成时交代先于主线的背景动作。

points.title: 条件状语从句 (Conditional Clauses)
points.explanation: if 引导条件从句，主句用 would 表示假设结果。本课用 if I spent less time...I would keep my mind fresh... 为自己放弃锻炼寻找借口，体现作者自我辩解的心理。

examples.en: I argued that if I spent less time exhausting myself at exercises in the morning, I would keep my mind fresh for reading when I got home formwork
examples.cn: 我辩解说，早晨少耗费精力锻炼，晚上下班回家看书时头脑更清醒些。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语作状语表示伴随状态或方式。本课用 After jumping about...and twisting... 描述锻炼时的动作，用 feeling cold and lonely 描述下楼看电视时的心情，生动再现作者的窘态。

examples.en: After jumping about on the carpet and twisting the human frame into uncomfortable positions, I sat down at the breakfast table in an exhausted condition.
examples.cn: 我在地毯上跳来蹦过去，扭曲身子，摆出各种姿势，弄得浑身不舒服，然后坐到桌边吃早饭，一副筋疲力尽的样子。

examples.en: One night, however, feeling cold and lonely, I went downstairs and sat in front of the television pretending to read.
examples.cn: 可是，有一天夜里，我感到又冷又孤单，便来到楼下坐在电视机前假装看书。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某一时间点」已完成的动作。本课用 By January 10th, I was back to where I had started from 中 had started from 交代「回到原来出发的状态」，即决心锻炼前的起点。

examples.en: By January 10th, I was back to where I had started from.
examples.cn: 到了1月10日，我恢复了原来的作息时间。

exercises.q: I argued that ______ I spent less time exhausting myself at exercises in the morning, I would keep my mind fresh for reading when I got home formwork
______ jumping about on the carpet and twisting the human frame into uncomfortable positions, I sat down at the breakfast table in an exhausted condition.
By January 10th, I was back to where I ______ started from.
用分词填空：One night, however, ______ cold and lonely, I went downstairs and sat in front of the television pretending to read.（写出 feel 的现在分词形式，作原因/伴随状语）
